amb_bike_kids.name: The Bike Kids
amb_bike_kids.p: A pack of 12-year-olds on bikes running notes for five cents. Breathless, overlapping, every line a different kid.

amb_deputy_lusk.name: Deputy Cal Lusk
amb_deputy_lusk.p: Off-duty Washoe deputy in pajama pants and a uniform jacket running the block watch and the marina water line. Self-important rules voice, a little loud, decent underneath.

carly.name: Carly Redmond
carly.p: Washoe 911 dispatcher, then the Switchboard. Triage cadence ('Address? Breathing? Okay.'), quick and precise, dark one-liners a beat after bad news. 'Babe' when it's light, 'Braith' when it isn't. Heat-tired in Ch1-2, hoarse and spent from radio nights by Act III but never slower on a count.

gil.name: Gil Shumway
gil.p: Retired NV Energy lineman with the block's only generator. 'Listen here.' Calls Braith 'flyboy'. Talks in prices, never says thank you; gravel from cigarettes and generator fumes, cracking at the fire.

kit.name: Kit Darrow
kit.p: Viaduct Crew runner: meds and rumors. Fast patter, nicknames ('Wrench'), deflects with jokes, never says hello. Whispering at the warning, frostbitten and hoarse pulling the Act III sled, radio-static at the end.

lolo.name: Dolores 'Lolo' Arrieta
lolo.p: Retired hospice nurse, Basque-American, Sparks. Warm, slow and unbendable; calls everyone 'maitia' (dear) and ends hard truths with a soft question after a beat. Carries a terrible list. Hushed and trembling in her Act III confession.

pruitt.name: Mr. Earl Pruitt
pruitt.p: Oxygen-concentrator neighbor who wanders to feed ducks that aren't there. Thin, gentle, confused; every phrase rides a shallow breath.

deshawn.name: Deshawn Pruitt
deshawn.p: Pruitt's grandson, 16. Earnest, quotes Grandpa, owes Braith one; steady and practical by Act III when he shows the cistern.

ross.name: Ross Pearce
ross.p: Hay rancher from Fallon, widower. Short rancher sentences with long gaps, says 'son' only when it matters. Sun-dried gravel; reads his feed-receipt letters close and quiet. Proud and stubborn at the blockade, breaking at the Fallon goodbye.

ames.name: Dr. Samuel Ames
ames.p: Truckee Meadows General triage doctor running on no sleep. Dry, rapid clinical shorthand ('If you're not bleeding, you're in the wrong building'), gallows humor. Slower and frayed by Act III.

trader_annie.name: Annie Tran
trader_annie.p: Librarian trading seeds and books at the Sparks library. Soft-spoken, precise, library metaphors; kneels in the Act III greenhouse.

augie.name: Augie Bell
augie.p: Ham operator KK7AUG on Peavine Peak. Slow, kind, digressive radio patter even in person ('This is KK7AUG, still here.'); calls Braith 'my ears in Sparks'. On air through a crackling ham chain; shaken thin by Dead Air.

avila.name: Capt. Lorna Avila
avila.p: Runs the Truckee Meadows Recovery Authority. Clipped command voice, numbers, controlled and compressed ('It's not a crime. It's a count.'); a softer human aside when the door closes. Sleepless by Act II; cracks at the break.

rosa.name: Rosa Esparza
rosa.p: Floor kitchen worker, mother of Mateo. In the Ch2 crush: breathless, terrified, then grateful in a rush.

trader_dutch.name: Dutch Albertson
trader_dutch.p: 4th Street pawn shop. Salesman patter: 'my friend', 'very interesting prices'. Friendly, fast, never quite trustworthy.

cpl_haas.name: Cpl. Haas
cpl_haas.p: Bored, decent checkpoint corporal on the Virginia Street bridge; flat, slightly nasal, drags his words in the heat. Bribable with cigarettes.

authority_guard.name: Recovery Authority guard
authority_guard.p: Tired Nevada Guard kid on crowd duty in the heat. Bored authority, loud enough for the line.

amb_lonnie.name: Lonnie Vance
amb_lonnie.p: Silver Spur lounge singer in a gold sequined jacket. Smooth crooner warmth, a showman's ease even in the ration line.

amb_brother_amos.name: Brother Amos
amb_brother_amos.p: Street preacher at the bridge who counts the dead aloud. Rolling pulpit cadence, outdoor echo.

amb_ruth.name: Ruth Calloway
amb_ruth.p: Retired second-grade teacher running class on yoga mats. Patient classroom warmth, crisp consonants; secretly the Night Owl.

walt.name: Walt Okada
walt.p: Retired Sierra Pacific plant operator; met on Peavine. Slow, technical, affectionate about machines ('That's the only good sound left in the world'). Deep, soft gravel with a smoker's wheeze and long coughs; by Act III on the sled, barely a whisper. Hollows later copy this voice on the ice.

amb_darlene.name: Darlene Okoye-Pratt
amb_darlene.p: Stranded long-haul trucker with a reefer of frozen chicken. Big, warm, CB-radio drawl with diesel gravel; armed and blunt.

amb_night_owl.name: The Night Owl
amb_night_owl.p: Anonymous radio voice reading the names of the missing every night: Ruth's voice, slower, through a crackling ham chain.

wes.name: Wes Pearce
wes.p: Braith's kid brother. Loud, reckless, ALL CAPS when excited ('BIG BROTHER'); idolizes and resents. Jokes through pain: gut-shot at the blockade he's gasping and still trying to be funny.

trader_rourke.name: Wendell Rourke
trader_rourke.p: Burro-train trader on the canyon roads. Old-West tall-tale cadence, talks to his burros, laughs at his own lines.

bridge_boy.name: Viaduct Crew kid
bridge_boy.p: Unnamed Viaduct Crew member under the I-80 viaduct. Bravado over fear.

pete_lund.name: Pete Lund
pete_lund.p: HVAC tech squatting at Galena with his kids. Defensive and scared at gunpoint, steadier as crew; shouting over the siege. (His voice is reused, sick, for the Ch8 husk.)

lund_kid.name: Mia Lund
lund_kid.p: Pete Lund's daughter. Small, serious, frightened of strangers, braver than her dad.

amb_salt.name: 'Salt'
amb_salt.p: Desert hermit in a culvert by the Steamboat hot springs; first to name the Tallmen. Dry, cracked, sun-baked rasp, odd pauses of someone who talks to nobody; by Ch9 frozen and faint.

ander.name: Ander Etcheverry
ander.p: Lahontan Compact leader, Basque sheep rancher. Slow preacher cadence with long pauses at commas; asks questions instead of giving orders; warm low voice outdoors.

trader_boone.name: SSgt. Tyrell Boone
trader_boone.p: Ironwood supply sergeant selling out the back door. Easy smile, salesman-soldier ('Very lost, very available'); nervous by Act III.

trader_mo.name: Maureen 'Mo' Kessinger
trader_mo.p: Mustang truck stop. Short, flat, Carhartt-tough; prices are final.

ruiz.name: Sgt. Nadia Ruiz
ruiz.p: Sgt. Nadia Ruiz, Ironwood combat engineer, call sign 'Engineer Two'. Plain soldier talk ('Orders are paper'), flat Army affect, short declaratives. Saw the Tallman; whispering on the picket, pinned and bleeding in the sweep.

trader_floor.name: Floor commissary
trader_floor.p: The Floor's commissary counter in the Silver Spur kitchens. Kitchen shouting over pans and a line.

amb_pvt_marsh.name: Pvt. Danny Marsh
amb_pvt_marsh.p: Ironwood deserter hiding in a 4th Street motel after refusing to clear a house with kids. Scared, young, whispering through a door.

ironwood_soldier.name: Ironwood soldier
ironwood_soldier.p: Unnamed Task Force Ironwood soldier. Exhausted kid, radio procedure, Fort Irwin on his mind.

roz.name: Roz Tafoya
roz.p: Runs the Floor out of dead casino kitchens. Calls everyone 'baby'; kitchen shouting that carries to the back of the Silver Spur; often heard over the Floor's radio.

amb_tolliver.name: Mr. Tolliver
amb_tolliver.p: Annex contractor guard who held the gate alone for 92 days, uniform still ironed. Over-formal, polite in a way that's coming apart; dehydrated and a little unhinged.

reyne.name: Dr. Hollis Reyne
reyne.p: Annex research physician. Precise, quiet, scientific vocabulary in measured sentences that crack under feeling. White-faced at the Henley house; whispers over what she named.

compact_rider.name: Lahontan Compact rider
compact_rider.p: Unnamed Compact rider at the Fallon checkpoint. Dusty farm-kid drawl with a rifle.

sfc_brandt.name: SFC Jim Brandt
sfc_brandt.p: Leader of the stranded Ironwood recovery detail at the Annex, Ruiz's old squadmate. Starving, sleepless, hanging on to procedure; his hands shake when he takes the food.

deserter.name: Ironwood deserter
deserter.p: Unnamed Ironwood deserter with Ruiz (Ch7); same casting as level extra deserter_1. Hollow-cheeked, hoarse, done.

stranger_mother.name: Mother from Sun Valley
stranger_mother.p: Mother at the sealed door in Ch8 with her kids. Frostbitten, hoarse, polite and desperate. A Hollow copies her voice at midnight.

hollow.name: Hollow (assimilated_human)
hollow.p: An assimilated person. Speaks only in copied phrases, in the voice of whoever it took or overheard. Rendered from the borrowed character's own base voice with no breath at all (no inhales, no cough, no shiver: Hollows draw warmth, they don't breathe), flat question-less intonation, every repeat the identical take, wrong pauses (a rushed join, then a hold too long, a hole mid-phrase), a faint metallic comb resonance and a dark 19 ms doubled shadow. Still recognisably the person.

husk.name: Husk (sick man in a T-shirt)
husk.p: Pete Lund as a husk: radiation-sick, hypothermic, paradoxically 'warm'. A person, not a monster: confused, wet, broken, voice can't hold pitch. Built from Pete's voice. Breath smokes (he's alive), unlike a Hollow.

column.name: The column (voice down the line)
column.p: Someone down the Ch9 column's rope line shouting into the whiteout.

kessler.name: Maj. Dale Kessler
kessler.p: Maj. Dale Kessler, Task Force Ironwood. Measured, deep, tonnages and casualty counts; never shouts. At Galena's gate in Ch10: cold, out of orders, still formal.

raider.name: Raider
raider.p: Viaduct Crew / scavenger crews under the I-80 viaduct and 4th Street. Mostly laid-off warehouse kids doing bravado. Act I-II (late summer heat into autumn).

looter.name: Looter
looter.p: Act I opportunists. Scared, fast, ashamed.

desperate_family.name: Desperate Family
desperate_family.p: Parents defending kids and a stash. Not villains; terrified and polite until they are not.

watch_militia.name: Watch Militia
watch_militia.p: Act I neighborhood watch. Self-important, a little thrilled, out of their depth.

authority_guard.name: Authority Guard
authority_guard.p: Truckee Meadows Recovery Authority / Nevada Guard. Tired kids on fourteen-hour shifts in the heat, legal orders, real fear.

compact_militia.name: Compact Militia
compact_militia.p: Lahontan Compact: Fallon and Mason Valley ranchers and farm families. Folksy, stubborn, protecting their valley's hay and grain from the Directive.

harbor_militia.name: Harbor Militia
harbor_militia.p: The Floor: casino workers, churches and UNR students feeding 3,000 a day out of dead Silver Spur kitchens. Collective, practical, loud.

ironwood.name: Ironwood
ironwood.p: Task Force Ironwood: federal soldiers out of Fort Irwin enforcing the Reconstruction Directive. Exhausted kids, radio procedure, generic squad call signs (Ironwood Two-Two, Three-One). 'Engineer Two' is reserved for Ruiz.

remnant.name: Remnant
remnant.p: Ironwood Remnant, Act III: holding the Sparks yard, masked against ash, frostbitten, no orders since the bursts in December. Muffled, hoarse, shivering.

husk.name: Husk
husk.p: Act III: radiation-sick, hypothermic, starving living people who have lost judgment. Human, confused, pleading; never monstrous. Breath smokes (alive) - NOT Hollows.

drone.name: Drone
drone.p: Ironwood surveillance drone PA: synthetic, monotone, legal-sounding. Vocoded.

trader.name: Trader
trader.p: Neutral barterers at markets, truck stops and camps, Act I-III. Gil's economy: prices, steel, 'we're square'.

deserter.name: Deserter
deserter.p: Ironwood deserters walking east with Ruiz (Ch7 level extras deserter_1 / deserter_2). Done with the war, hoarse, hungry, not looking for a fight.

boot_strippers.name: Boot Strippers
boot_strippers.p: Scavengers stripping boots from the dead on the frozen Truckee (Ch9 level extras). Frozen, ashamed, muttering.

hollow.name: Hollow
hollow.p: Hollow mimicry (assimilated_human), Ch8-10. Copied phrases in a BORROWED voice: the same take repeated with identical inflection, wrong pauses, no breath. Lines marked story come verbatim from gameplay_hooks.json voice_lines / the Ch8-10 scenes; the rest are placeholders. playBark('assimilated_human', 'mimic', { borrow: 'walt' }).

ch01_block_ambient.a1.t: Mister! Mister with the dog! Is it true the Chinese did it? Jaden says it was a nuke.

ch01_block_ambient.sun.t: The SUN? That's so much worse. You can't fight the sun.

ch01_block_ambient.nobody.t: Okay but if it WAS a nuke, can we see it?

ch01_block_ambient.a2.t: We're doing deliveries. Notes between houses. Five cents a note. Or a granola bar.

ch01_block_ambient.a3.t: Curfew's dusk on this street. Not official. Mine. Don't make me be official.

ch01_carly_home.c1.t: Hi. Hi, baby. Yes. I know. I smell like a server room.

ch01_carly_home.c3.t: They sent the day shift home. Generator's got maybe a week. The phones died Tuesday. We kept talking anyway.

ch01_carly_home.coffee.t: It's warm as bathwater, isn't it. I don't care. Give it here.

ch01_carly_home.like.t: Radio only. Calls from patrol cars. People walking in off the street to report things.

ch01_carly_home.like2.t: A man walked six miles to tell us his wife died. He just wanted someone to write it down.

ch01_carly_home.wrote.t: Address, time, name. Yeah. That's the job. You write it down so it happened.

ch01_carly_home.leave.t: Yerington's seventy miles of nothing. And I'm back on shift Thursday.

ch01_carly_home.leave2.t: Braith. Somebody has to answer. Even if it's just a guy on a bike.

ch01_carly_home.plan2.t: Lolo came by. She's worried about Mr. Pruitt. His oxygen machine needs a plug.

ch01_carly_home.plan3.t: And Gil's running a generator like it's the Fourth of July. Somebody should ask him nicely.

ch01_carly_home.plan4.t: I'm going to sleep for four hours. Wake me if the world ends again.

ch01_gil_garage.g1.t: Listen here. Shut that door. You're letting my electricity out.

ch01_gil_garage.g_pruitt.t: If this is about Pruitt, I said it to the nurse. Can't run the whole block off one Kubota.

ch01_gil_garage.g2.t: You want diesel, I want something worth diesel. That's the economy now, flyboy.

ch01_gil_garage.price.t: Cash is kindling. Guns, tools, meds. That tool roll of yours? Snap-on? That's a jug.

ch01_gil_garage.trade.t: Good steel. Five gallons. We're square.

ch01_gil_garage.trade3.t: I'll keep it oiled. You'll want it back. Everybody wants their tools back.

ch01_gil_garage.help.t: I am helping. I'm helping me. Somebody's got to be ready when the help runs out.

ch01_gil_garage.help2.t: Thirty-one years on diesel at the Sparks yard. Pension's a joke now. This is my pension.

ch01_gil_garage.pruitt.t: ...One night. One. And you didn't get it from me.

ch01_gil_garage.pruitt_no.t: No. Ask me again in a week when you've done me a favor. Go on.

ch01_gil_garage.sticker.t: ...The station manager was gone. Pumps were dead. I had a hand pump. You'd have done the same.

ch01_gil_garage.sticker2.t: You want to tell somebody, go ahead. Who're you gonna tell?

ch01_kit_pharmacy.k1.t: Okay. Okay okay. Call off the wolf. I'm not armed. I mean I am. But not at you.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.hold.t: Wow. Cool. Very effective. I am extremely cooperative now.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.k2.t: Kit. Hi. Shelves are mostly picked. I got the back room. Antibiotics, gauze, blood pressure stuff.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.nurse.t: A nurse? Real one? ...Fine. Take the gauze and the amoxicillin. I'm not a monster.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.n2.t: The rest goes to the Viaduct. People there are sick too, Wrench. Nobody's bringing them a nurse.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.who.t: Whoever's got food. Mostly the guys under the viaduct. They had warehouse jobs on Monday.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.down.t: Or what? You'll shoot a girl in a CVS for Lipitor? Come on.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.all2.t: Cool. Cool. You're one of those. I'll remember the dog.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.note2.t: ...You left a NOTE? Who's gonna read it? Oh my god. You're adorable. Bye, Wrench.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.let.t: Pleasure doing crime with you. If anyone asks, I was never here. Neither was the wolf.

ch01_kit_pharmacy.watch_bad.t: Pearce. That's a big bag. What's in the big bag?

ch01_kit_pharmacy.clinic.t: ...Lolo. Fine. Tell her my mom's pills ran out. She knows which.

ch01_lolo_porch.start.t: Braith, maitia. You look like a man who slept in his boots. Come. Sit.

ch01_lolo_porch.l1.t: Mr. Pruitt, three houses down. Eighty-four. His oxygen machine needs a wall plug.

ch01_lolo_porch.l2.t: His bottles run out tonight. After that he breathes on his own. He cannot.

ch01_lolo_porch.l3.t: You have a gas can in your truck. Gil has a generator he won't share. You see where I'm going.

ch01_lolo_porch.how.t: With the machine, months. Without it, maybe Thursday. Maybe Friday if he's stubborn.

ch01_lolo_porch.l4.t: I'm not asking you to choose, maitia. I'm telling you a choice exists. That's all.

ch01_lolo_porch.give.t: Thank you. He'll complain about the noise. That's how you'll know he's alive.

ch01_lolo_porch.give2.t: One more thing. He wandered off this morning. Confused. His grandson's out looking.

ch01_lolo_porch.ranch.t: Your father's ranch. Of course. Family first. I would do the same.

ch01_lolo_porch.ranch3.t: Then you're not going anywhere either. Keep the gas. Keep it close.

ch01_lolo_porch.gen.t: A warm house is not nothing. Fine. I would hate it too.

ch01_lolo_porch.gil.t: I asked. He said 'listen here' and then said no for five minutes. Try. He likes mechanics.

ch01_lolo_porch.scarf.t: Pruitt walked off at dawn. Deshawn found only this by the canal. Your dog has a nose, no?

ch01_marina_water.m1.t: Hey. Pearce, right? Stead hangar guy. Fill up and move along. We're doing one trip a family.

ch01_marina_water.rule.t: I did. Somebody has to. Yesterday two guys fought over a Home Depot bucket. One went in.

ch01_marina_water.rule2.t: Water's warm and green and ten feet deep off the dock. He came out. Next one might not.

ch01_marina_water.extra2.t: ...I saw that. Your dog's a better liar than you are. Go home.

ch01_pruitt_found.p2.t: There you are. Thought the Air Force forgot about me.

ch01_pruitt_found.what.t: Ducks. The power's out. Somebody has to feed the ducks.

ch01_pruitt_found.p3.t: Grandpa! You can't do that. You can't just—

ch01_pruitt_found.p4g.t: Ms. Lolo says you gave the gas. I... thanks. For real. I owe you one.

ch01_pruitt_found.p4.t: Thanks, man. Your dog's a genius. Grandpa, inside. Now.

ch01_voicemail.v1.t: It still has the voicemail. From Sunday. You never listened to it.

ch01_voicemail.play.t: Braith. It's Dad. Sky's doing something crazy out here. Green, all the way down to Walker Lake.

ch01_voicemail.v2.t: Radio says the grid's going. Not just us. Everywhere. Listen. Come home, both of you, before—

ch01_voicemail.v4.t: Seventy miles. You could make it on what we've got.

ch01_voicemail.v_gas.t: You kept the gas for this. I saw. It's okay. I'd have done the same.

ch01_voicemail.v_nogas.t: Well. Maybe not on what we've got.

ch01_voicemail.v5.t: I'm not leaving. People are still walking into dispatch. Somebody has to write it down.

ch01_voicemail.family.t: I know. So go. I mean it. I'll be here.

ch01_voicemail.soon.t: Don't promise me soon. Nobody gets soon anymore.

ch02_ames_diesel_return.start.t: You got it. Nobody's dead. I'm genuinely surprised on both counts.

ch02_ames_diesel_return.a1.t: Here. Antibiotics, gauze, a suture kit. For the Basque nurse. She's better than half my residents.

ch02_ames_diesel_return.a2.t: And a letter to Avila. You fixed a hospital generator. You get the essential card. Today.

ch02_ames_diesel_return.a3.t: If you ever get real power going, anywhere, come find me first. I mean that as a threat.

ch02_ames_hospital.a1.t: If you're not bleeding, you're in the wrong building. If you are, take a number. They're on the wall.

ch02_ames_hospital.look.t: ...Can you? God. Yes. And the other thing. There's a fuel truck stuck on level three of the parking ramp.

ch02_ames_hospital.meds.t: Everyone needs antibiotics. I need diesel. Maybe we can help each other.

ch02_ames_hospital.diesel.t: Five hundred gallons in a tanker on level three. People are living up there. They won't let my staff near it.

ch02_ames_hospital.guard.t: Because the Guard would shoot someone, and then I'd have to treat them. Please.

ch02_ames_hospital.yes.t: Thank you. Bring it to the loading dock. Pump's dead; you'll need to gravity-feed it.

ch02_ames_hospital.yes2.t: I'll make it worth your while. And your nurse friend's while.

ch02_ames_hospital.no.t: Fair enough. Nobody's fight. That's the problem with everything.

ch02_annie_table.a1.t: Hello. I'm Annie, Sparks branch. Well, I was. I'm still. The library didn't close, the building did.

ch02_annie_table.a2.t: Seeds, a few books, some antibiotics a vet donated. I trade for batteries, wire, glass. Or labor.

ch02_annie_table.trade.t: Thank you. Use them on someone who'll argue with you about it. Those ones live.

ch02_annie_table.why.t: Somebody will, next spring. That's the whole idea of a library, really.

ch02_annie_table.labor.t: The library has a glass atrium. If anyone ever gets power again, it's a greenhouse. Think about it.

ch02_annie_table.a3.t: Come by the branch on Pyramid Way when you can. Bring a story. I'm collecting those too.

ch02_augie_radio.r1.t: This is KK7AUG, Peavine Peak, still here. Day nineteen. Here's what I've got.

ch02_augie_radio.r2.t: Sacramento's got power downtown. Allegedly. Salt Lake's handing out MREs at the fairgrounds. Allegedly.

ch02_augie_radio.r3.t: Transformer shipments from Korea in ninety days. I'd like that one to be true. So would you.

ch02_augie_radio.r4.t: If you've got a radio and batteries, get to me. I need ears in Sparks. KK7AUG, out.

ch02_avila_registry.r1.t: Name, address, household. Skills. Be honest about skills; it changes your ration tier.

ch02_avila_registry.why.t: Because pumps, trucks and generators keep this valley alive. And people who fix them eat first.

ch02_avila_registry.skills.t: F-15 crew chief? Mountain Home? ...Pearce, you just became the most useful man in this room.

ch02_avila_registry.r2.t: Essential worker card. Double rations, travel pass. You work my motor pool three days a week.

ch02_avila_registry.r3.t: One more thing. Anyone on your block holding fuel or food over thirty days? It's not a crime. It's a count.

ch02_avila_registry.report.t: Thank you. That's how this works. Card's yours, effective today.

ch02_avila_registry.no.t: Then you're on the standard queue for the card. Two weeks. Unless the motor pool needs you sooner.

ch02_avila_registry.quiet.t: If this hall hears forty-one, I have a riot by noon and nobody gets anything. Help me buy time.

ch02_avila_registry.quiet2.t: Card's yours. Not as a bribe. Because you know, and I need people who know.

ch02_carly_desk.start.t: Don't be mad. Avila asked for anyone with dispatch experience. I can type ninety words a minute.

ch02_carly_desk.c1.t: They need people who can talk to scared people. That's literally my whole job.

ch02_carly_desk.c_truth2.t: ...I know. I've seen the sheets. I'm going to find out why before I decide anything. Okay?

ch02_carly_desk.c2.t: Say something. You have your mechanic face. The one where you're listening for a bad bearing.

ch02_carly_desk.back.t: Thank you. Seriously. I needed one person not to look at me like I joined a cult.

ch02_carly_desk.argue.t: Everyone's making lists, Braith. I'd rather it was someone who reads the names out loud.

ch02_carly_desk.quit.t: And do what, hand you wrenches? Nope. I'm good at this. Let me be good at something.

ch02_carly_desk.c3.t: Go get your rations. Get out before the line turns. It turns every day around two.

ch02_crush.mom.t: Mateo! Mijo— Thank you. Thank you. I'm Rosa. We're with the Floor. At the Silver Spur. Anything.

ch02_crush.mom2.t: If you ever need something, ask for Rosa in the kitchen. I mean it. I don't forget.

ch02_dutch_pawn.d1.t: Welcome, welcome. Dutch Albertson. Everything has a price, my friend, and today the prices are very interesting.

ch02_dutch_pawn.d2.t: Cash? I'll still take cash. For about a week. After that it's kindling.

ch02_dutch_pawn.stock.t: Tools, a few guns, cigarettes, a very nice bass boat. Meds, if you don't ask where from.

ch02_dutch_pawn.want.t: Batteries. Ammo. Jewelry, for sentimental people. And news. News is the new gold.

ch02_dutch_pawn.trade.t: Pleasure. You come back. Dutch remembers good customers. And bad ones.

ch02_dutch_pawn.d3.t: Also, a free tip: don't walk 4th Street after dark. The viaduct boys are hungry and not shy.

ch02_haas_checkpoint.h1.t: ID. Address. Is that a dog or a lawsuit?

ch02_haas_checkpoint.dog.t: Huh. MWD? ...Washout? Yeah. She's got washout eyes. Like me. Okay.

ch02_haas_checkpoint.id.t: Pearce. Sparks. You carrying meds, fuel or firearms? I have to search for meds, fuel or firearms.

ch02_haas_checkpoint.bribe.t: I'm gonna search this bag with my eyes closed. Wow. Nothing in here. Go.

ch02_haas_checkpoint.truth.t: ...The Basque lady? She stitched my cousin's hand in '19. Fine. I didn't see a bag.

ch02_haas_checkpoint.clean.t: Okay. Ration line's in the convention center. Bring something to sit on. It's three hours.

ch02_kit_line.know.t: Wrench! And the wolf! Okay, you didn't see that. You're my alibi.

ch02_kit_line.stranger.t: Oh. You. The bag guy. Please don't make this weird.

ch02_kit_line.k1.t: Hey! You in the goggles. Hands where I can see them.

ch02_kit_line.cover.t: Together. Right. Both of you, step out. You lose your place. Next time I take the cards.

ch02_kit_line.cover2.t: You lost your spot for me. That's so stupid. Okay. Listen.

ch02_kit_line.tip.t: At the desk they ask you for names. Hoarders. Don't give names. Names come back around.

ch02_kit_line.tipend.t: I owe you. I actually pay my debts. Ask anyone. Don't ask anyone.

ch02_lonnie_line.l1.t: Thank you, thank you. Lonnie Vance, Silver Spur lounge, Tuesdays and Thursdays. Well. Formerly.

ch02_lonnie_line.l2.t: I take requests. I also take crackers. The crackers are not optional.

ch02_lonnie_line.give.t: Sir, you are a patron of the arts. This one's for you and the wolf.

ch02_lonnie_line.no.t: No? No. That's fair. Nobody's got crackers. I'll sing anyway. Union rules.

ch02_lonnie_line.amos.t: Nineteen days! Two hundred and six dead in this county that I know of! I'm counting! Somebody has to count!

ch02_ruth_class.r1.t: If your family has three cans and four people, how much does each person get? Anyone?

ch02_ruth_class.r3.t: Thirty-eight years of second grade. Never had a class this good at fractions. Isn't that awful?

ch03_augie_peavine.a1.t: Sparks! My ears in Sparks! Come in, shut the door. Augie Bell. This is Walt. Walt, be nice.

ch03_augie_peavine.a2.t: The big rig's down. Final's cooked. Somebody said there's a kid in Sparks who fixes airplanes.

ch03_augie_peavine.pay.t: Your name on the air, a cup of something hot, and the best gossip in the Great Basin.

ch03_augie_peavine.a3.t: This is KK7AUG, back on the air with a NEW final, courtesy of a genuine United States Air Force crew chief!

ch03_augie_peavine.a4.t: ...Between us? Half the good news I read is made up. Korea ships? I made that up. People need it.

ch03_augie_peavine.lie.t: It's hope with a little extra salt. Walt thinks I'm going to hell. Walt, tell him.

ch03_augie_peavine.w1.t: He's going to hell. ...You're Pearce. Turbines. Avila's people say you know turbines.

ch03_augie_peavine.w2.t: Walt Okada. I ran the control room at Galena Station twenty-two years. The geothermal plant. Steamboat.

ch03_augie_peavine.w3.t: The wells don't care about the grid. Water comes up at three hundred twenty degrees whether America exists or not.

ch03_augie_peavine.w4.t: But you can't start the plant cold. Pumps, controls, the cooling fans. You need outside power to wake it up.

ch03_augie_peavine.why.t: [Coughs for a long time.] Lungs. Forty years of hydrogen sulfide. I can tell you. I can't climb.

ch03_augie_peavine.cart.t: Air Guard ramp at the airport. Ninety-kilowatt carts for the C-130s. One of those would do it. Barely.

ch03_augie_peavine.w6.t: Galena's warm. Galena could heat a hospital. Maybe half of Reno. Who do you tell?

ch03_carly_count.c1.t: Stores sheets. Every warehouse in the valley. Avila's been reporting a hundred and forty days. It's forty-one.

ch03_carly_count.c2.t: Forty-one days, Braith. As of Tuesday. Thirty-six now.

ch03_carly_count.c_knew.t: ...You knew. Since the registry. You knew and you let me type names into that thing for a month.

ch03_carly_count.time.t: She asked YOU. Nobody asked me. Okay. Noted. Very noted.

ch03_carly_count.sorry.t: Yeah. You should've. ...Okay. I'm still mad. I'm also glad it's you.

ch03_carly_count.c3.t: If I take this to the Floor, there's a riot. If I sit on it, I'm Avila. What do I do?

ch03_carly_count.roz.t: Roz. Yeah. She'll yell, then she'll feed people. Okay.

ch03_carly_count.sit.t: Buy time. Right. That's what she said too.

ch03_carly_count.yours.t: ...I'm going to keep a copy. And I'm going to keep counting. My count.

ch03_darlene_camp.d1.t: Darlene. Phoenix to Boise, chicken. Got stuck at the Mustang exit Day Zero. Chicken's frozen, at least.

ch03_darlene_camp.d2.t: I been feeding the shelter on Greg Street. Can't move a forty-ton truck on what's left in the tank.

ch03_darlene_camp.run.t: Ten days. Then it's six thousand pounds of chicken thawing in the desert. Make it make sense.

ch03_darlene_camp.help.t: Well bless you. Come by anytime. I'll fry you a wing on the manifold.

ch03_gil_fire.f2.t: I'm going. Get the extinguisher. Braith, the extinguisher—

ch03_gil_fire.stay.t: No. I'm the one who knows where his bedroom is. Cover me or don't.

ch03_gil_fire.after.t: My tools. Thirty-one years of tools. ...Listen here. Thank you. Don't make it weird.

ch03_gil_fire.after_tools.t: Your tool roll was in my truck. Truck's fine. It's yours. You'll need it more than me.

ch03_kit_warning.k1.t: Don't talk. Listen. The Viaduct guys are hitting Gil's garage tonight. For the diesel.

ch03_kit_warning.k2.t: They've got bottles. Gas bottles. Somebody's going to burn that garage, Wrench.

ch03_kit_warning.how.t: Because I scouted it. Okay? I walked by twice. They paid me in soup. I'm sorry.

ch03_kit_warning.how2.t: I didn't know they had bottles. I swear I didn't know about the bottles.

ch03_kit_warning.harsh.t: Yeah. I did. You want to fight about soup or you want to wake up your neighbor?

ch03_night_owl.o1.t: This is the Night Owl. Here are tonight's names. If you know them, say them out loud where you are.

ch03_night_owl.o2.t: Dolores Paiz, Sun Valley. Marcus Webb, Sparks. Two children, unnamed, the Wells Avenue fire.

ch03_night_owl.o3.t: If you're missing someone, find a radio. I read every name I get. Goodnight. Keep each other warm.

ch03_plant_secret.s1.t: Whoever helps you light it is going to own it. You know that, right? Pick carefully.

ch03_plant_secret.auth.t: Avila. Okay. Then she owes you. Make her remember it.

ch03_plant_secret.floor.t: Roz will make soup out of a power plant. I love that, honestly.

ch03_plant_secret.compact.t: For real? Dad's gonna lose it. Ander'll send riders. You'll have the whole valley behind you.

ch03_plant_secret.compact2.t: The whole valley that's blockading the city we live in. Sure. Great.

ch03_plant_secret.none.t: Just you, a dying man and a stolen airplane cart. That's either genius or a eulogy.

ch03_rourke_road.r1.t: Whoa, Maisie. Afternoon! Wendell Rourke, Virginia City. I trade. Stories and salt, mostly.

ch03_rourke_road.r2.t: I'll sell you a candle for a story. Real one. If it's good I'll throw in tea.

ch03_rourke_road.story.t: Hm. That's a good one. Sad, but good. Father stories always are. Here.

ch03_rourke_road.rumor.t: Ohh, that's a juicy one. Whiskey for you. Don't tell Maisie.

ch03_rourke_road.east.t: Out east? Fallon's organized. Good folks, armed folks. And Dixie Valley's got a fence nobody talks about.

ch03_rourke_road.r3.t: Something got loose out there, the sheepmen say. Took forty head in a night. No blood on the sage. Ha. Tall tales.

ch03_wes_arrives.w2.t: BRAITH! Big brother! You look terrible! I brought beef!

ch03_wes_arrives.w4.t: Dad sent me. Here. He wrote it on a feed receipt because he's Dad.

ch03_wes_arrives.w6.t: He won't say it, so I will. He's scared. He keeps the radio on all night.

ch03_wes_arrives.ander.t: Sheep guy from Fallon. Basque. Talks like a preacher. He's got the farms working together. It's actually cool.

ch03_wes_arrives.w6b.t: They're calling it the Compact. Water, feed, trucks. Dad's like his right hand now.

ch03_wes_arrives.stay.t: Here? In the city? With the gangs and the line? ...Okay. A week. For Carly's cooking. Not yours.

ch03_wes_arrives.stay2.t: I don't cook. I boil things. Welcome to the boiling house, Wes.

ch03_wes_arrives.home.t: Yeah. Okay. Write him something back. He'll read it like forty times.

ch04_airguard_ramp.talk.t: Who's there? ...Wait. Are you motor pool? You look like motor pool.

ch04_airguard_ramp.bluff.t: Nobody tells me anything. Sign here. Bring it back with gas in it.

ch04_airguard_ramp.honest.t: Crew chief? I'm a Guard cook. They gave me a rifle and a barrel. ...Take it. I didn't see.

ch04_black_start.b1.t: Easy. Easy. Watch the pressure. Watch it. ...Now. Close it.

ch04_black_start.b4.t: Ha. Ha! You hear that? That's a turbine, son. That's the only good sound left in the world.

ch04_black_start.b5.t: One line out. One feeder. Where does the first power go?

ch04_black_start.hosp.t: Hospital. Good. Ames will cry. He won't admit it.

ch04_black_start.floor.t: Roz's kitchens. A thousand hot meals a day. Not bad, kid.

ch04_black_start.auth.t: Avila. Okay. Lights in a room full of lists. Your call.

ch04_dutch_ambush.a1.t: Nice cart, airman. Dutch says it's worth a lot. Dutch says you're cheap.

ch04_lunds.l1.t: That's far enough. This is ours. We were here first. Take your dog and go.

ch04_lunds.l2.t: Dad. Dad, the dog's nice. Look at her. Dad.

ch04_lunds.warm.t: Warm how? It's a dead power plant.

ch04_lunds.lower.t: ...You're putting it down? Okay. Okay. I'm Pete. We came up from Pleasant Valley. House burned.

ch04_lunds.stay.t: Crew. Okay. I can turn a wrench. I worked HVAC at the Peppermill.

ch04_lunds.go.t: ...Thanks. Really. Tell the next guy we were here first.

ch04_salt_culvert.s1.t: Stop. Turn the lights off. You're shining right up the draw.

ch04_salt_culvert.s2.t: Name's Salt. Been here since '09. Warm water, nobody bothers me. Till September.

ch04_salt_culvert.food.t: Huh. Thanks. Okay. You get the long version.

ch04_salt_culvert.nov.t: They've been watching me since September. Tall ones. They stand where the steam is and they watch.

ch04_salt_culvert.s3.t: They don't come close. Not yet. They like the warm. Your plant up there is the warmest thing for miles.

ch04_salt_culvert.s5.t: Your dog knows. Dogs always know. Go on. Light your plant. Keep your lights on.

ch04_salt_culvert.light.t: ...Huh. Nobody's given me anything in fifteen years but tickets. Thank you, airman.

ch04_standoff.s1.t: You did it. Good. Now the plant is under the Recovery Authority. Feeders go where my list says.

ch04_standoff.s2.t: Lady, the plant goes where the steam says. I've been here twenty-two years.

ch04_standoff.with.t: ...I'll leave four guards. Not as a threat. As insurance.

ch04_standoff.yours.t: Thank you. That's how we survive. Somebody has to own it.

ch04_standoff.no.t: I can't make you. Yet. Remember I asked nicely.

ch05_ander_blockade.start.t: Ander Etcheverry. Lahontan Compact. I want to talk to the mechanic, not the Army.

ch05_ander_blockade.a1.t: Thirty trucks of food leave Nevada tonight. Our old people eat sagebrush tea. Explain to me the justice.

ch05_ander_blockade.dad.t: You got my letter. ...You came anyway. On their side.

ch05_ander_blockade.nobody.t: That's the lie everybody tells right before they pick a side.

ch05_ander_blockade.reno.t: Reno's side. Okay. Your mother would've liked her. That doesn't change the road.

ch05_ander_blockade.please.t: Can't. Every rancher in Mason Valley is behind me. I made them promises.

ch05_ander_blockade.ander.t: Your father is a good man. He's the reason half these men came. Think about that.

ch05_ander_blockade.choice.t: So. Do the trucks roll, or do they stay in Nevada?

ch05_boone_backdoor.b1.t: Tyrell Boone. Staff sergeant. I'm the guy who knows what fell off the truck. Lots fell off the truck.

ch05_boone_backdoor.b2.t: MREs. Filters. Five-five-six. All very lost, all very available. I want cigarettes, whiskey, and silence.

ch05_boone_backdoor.trade.t: Pleasure. Filters are fresh. Mostly. Probably.

ch05_boone_backdoor.trade2.t: Enjoy. Chili-mac is the good one. Don't let anybody tell you different.

ch05_boone_backdoor.co.t: My CO knows the war's lost and the trucks are full. We all know. Want to buy something or not?

ch05_boone_backdoor.end.t: Come back with an ID or something to drink. I'm here 'til I'm not.

ch05_mo_truckstop.m1.t: Maureen Kessinger. Mo. I don't do credit, I don't do sob stories, and I don't do the Army.

ch05_mo_truckstop.m2.t: Compact taxes me on the way in. Army taxes me on the way out. Prices are what they are.

ch05_mo_truckstop.pump.t: ...You hear that from out here? Huh. Fix my transfer pump and you get standing credit. Fair?

ch05_mo_truckstop.deal2.t: Well. Damn. You're on the list, mechanic. Good list. The only list I keep.

ch05_mo_truckstop.darlene.t: Darlene says you helped her too. She's moving her rig here. Chicken and diesel. We'll be fine.

ch05_mo_truckstop.trade.t: Jug's full. I checked. Don't make me regret that.

ch05_mo_truckstop.end.t: Drive safe. Nobody's coming if you don't.

ch05_rourke_canyon.start.t: My friend! Help an old man. Maisie won't walk past the soldiers and the soldiers won't walk past Maisie.

ch05_rourke_canyon.r1.t: Get us through the canyon and I'll give you the best thing I own. A rumor. A good one.

ch05_rourke_canyon.yes.t: Here's my rumor, worth every step: the fenced place in Dixie Valley has its own power. Hardened. Military.

ch05_rourke_canyon.yes2.t: Whatever's out there came from inside that fence. Ask the sheepmen. Ask anybody who's been east.

ch05_rourke_canyon.no.t: Ah. Another time. Maisie forgives. I hold grudges for her.

ch05_ruiz_convoy.r1.t: You're the mechanic. Pearce. I'm Ruiz, Engineer Two. You ride the lead truck. If it stops, you start it.

ch05_ruiz_convoy.r2.t: The Directive says this food feeds Sacramento. Sacramento's eating rats. I've seen it. That's the truth.

ch05_ruiz_convoy.reno.t: Reno eats what's left. I know. I don't love it. I'm a combat engineer, not a philosopher.

ch05_ruiz_convoy.orders.t: Orders are paper. I follow the ones I can live with. Today I can live with this one. Barely.

ch05_ruiz_convoy.quiet.t: Smart. Say nothing. It's the only thing they can't requisition.

ch05_ruiz_convoy.r3.t: Compact's blocking the canyon. Farmers with deer rifles and hay trucks. If they shoot, we shoot. Please don't make me.

ch05_signal_cabinet.c1.t: Get those floods on and we can see their positions. Get the gates up and we roll through.

ch05_signal_cabinet.jam.t: ...It's dead? Fine. Then we wait. Waiting is how people get shot, Pearce.

ch05_wes_wounded.w1.t: Hey. Hey, big brother. I'm fine. This is fine. I'm so fine.

ch05_wes_wounded.w3.t: He's Compact. If my people find him, he's a detainee. If he's a detainee, he's a number.

ch05_wes_wounded.treat.t: ...I didn't see a Compact fighter. I saw a mechanic's brother. Go. Before I see him.

ch05_wes_wounded.treat2.t: Dad's gonna kill you for this. Then hug you. Then kill you again.

ch05_wes_wounded.ross.t: ...Thank you, son. Go back. Before someone shoots you for walking both ways.

ch05_wes_wounded.army.t: I'll get him a medic. I'll try to get him a good one. That's all I can promise.

ch06_alley_glimpse.g_ruiz.t: [Behind you, very quietly] You saw that. Tell me you saw that.

ch06_alley_glimpse.g_ruiz2.t: Third one this month. Patrol logs say 'animal.' Patrols that see them stop writing logs.

ch06_avila_break.a1.t: The governor orders me to resist the Directive. Fort Irwin orders me to assist Ironwood. Both are legal.

ch06_avila_break.a2.t: Tonight Ironwood moves a Bradley through the rail trench to take the Floor's warehouses. I have to pick.

ch06_avila_break.count.t: The real one? Thirty-one days. If the warehouses go west, it's nine.

ch06_avila_break.count2.t: ...Fine. Fine. Nine days is murder with paperwork.

ch06_avila_break.gov.t: God help me. Okay. The Guard holds the bridges. The Army holds everything else. Get to the trench.

ch06_avila_break.dir.t: Thank you. It's the only order I know how to give. Stay out of the trench tonight, Pearce.

ch06_carly_side.c1.t: Station Six, copy, two hypothermia cases and a broken leg on Kietzke. Runner's on the way. Switchboard out.

ch06_carly_side.c2.t: Hi. I quit. I took the stores sheets. Augie and I built a radio relay. Twelve neighborhoods. It works.

ch06_carly_side.c3.t: [Over the radio] She's a natural! I've been doing this forty years and she makes me look like a ham sandwich.

ch06_carly_side.c4.t: I need to decide who the Switchboard works with. It can't stay neutral. Nothing can, now.

ch06_carly_side.harbor.t: The Floor. Yeah. They're messy and they buy guns, but they feed everyone who walks in.

ch06_carly_side.auth.t: Avila, if she breaks. She's a liar. She's also the only one with a count. Even a fake one.

ch06_carly_side.compact.t: Your dad. ...I get it. I don't love it. Fine. For now.

ch06_carly_side.yours.t: Then I choose... the Floor. Because Rosa's kid waves at me every morning. That's my reason.

ch06_carly_side.yours2.t: Go. Avila's at the old Harrah's. She's trying to decide whose side she's on too.

ch06_floor_commissary.f1.t: Chips or labor, honey. Soup's lentil. Bread's yesterday's. Blankets are for families.

ch06_floor_commissary.soup.t: Bowl back when you're done. We count the bowls too.

ch06_floor_commissary.work2.t: You scrub like a mechanic. Thorough and mad about it. Here's your chip.

ch06_floor_commissary.guns.t: Nobody. And if Roz asks, I said nobody twice.

ch06_informant_list.gil1.t: Listen here. The Authority came for my diesel in September. Then the Viaduct came for the rest. Then the fire.

ch06_informant_list.sorry.t: Scared. Yeah. Everybody's scared. I'm scared, and I don't put names on lists.

ch06_informant_list.everyone.t: Then everyone can go to hell. You first.

ch06_informant_list.tear.t: ...Doesn't un-say it. But fine. Fine. Don't talk to me for a while.

ch06_informant_list.off.t: My name's on there. For reporting a guy with a meth lab in '22. Funny how lists remember.

ch06_informant_list.tear2.t: Thanks. Not that it matters. They've got copies. Lists always have copies.

ch06_marsh_motel.m1.t: Don't— Please. I'm not armed. I left it. I left it in the river.

ch06_marsh_motel.m3.t: Danny Marsh. Private. They told us to clear a house on Wells. There were kids in the house. I just walked.

ch06_marsh_motel.hide.t: Thank you. Thank you. I'll— I don't know what I'll do. Thank you.

ch06_marsh_motel.east.t: East. Okay. The farmers. They'll shoot me. ...Better them than us.

ch06_ruiz_pinned.r1.t: Pearce. Funny. Don't laugh, it hurts. Either help me or go. I won't blame you either way.

ch06_ruiz_pinned.list.t: The sweep lists? I skip kids' houses. Pencil marks. Two dots means kids. I mark them clear.

ch06_ruiz_pinned.list2.t: Kessler doesn't know. Now you do. So. Door?

ch06_ruiz_pinned.free2.t: Engineer Two owes you. Here. My ID. It'll get you through one checkpoint. Don't waste it.

ch06_ruiz_pinned.free3.t: And the Bradley: it's coming down the trench from Lake Street. There's a stalled freight car on the siding.

ch06_ruiz_pinned.wes_out.t: Your brother's in the detainee cage at the yard. I'll get him out tonight. Count on it.

ch06_sweep.s1.t: Typhoid. Ha. There are two cases and both are mine. They're looking for guns, maitia.

ch06_sweep.s2.t: I have morphine in the clinic. The Pruitts have six months of food in the crawlspace. They'll take it all.

ch06_sweep.declare.t: Declare it. Yes. And then they declare it theirs. You'll see.

ch06_sweep.door.t: Open up! Sector four inspection! Restrain the dog!

ch06_trench.t1.t: [Over the radio] Pearce! Baby! Whatever you're doing up there, do it now! They're at the warehouse gates!

ch06_trench.block2.t: THAT'S MY MECHANIC! Baby, you eat free at the Spur for the rest of your life! However long that is!

ch07_annex_gate.g1.t: Halt. Sir. Ma'am. This is a restricted facility. State your business and your clearance.

ch07_annex_gate.g3.t: Tolliver. It's Dr. Reyne. Level three. You know me. You let me out.

ch07_annex_gate.g4.t: Dr. Reyne. You left. Everyone left. I was told to hold the gate until relieved. I have not been relieved.

ch07_annex_gate.relieve.t: ...By whose authority? ...No. No, there's nobody left to authorize anything, is there.

ch07_annex_gate.over.t: Ninety-two days. I kept a log. Would you like to see it? Nobody's seen it.

ch07_annex_gate.raise.t: Sir, I will defend this post.

ch07_annex_gate.g5.t: The doors are maglocked. Dead power means locked forever. You'd need a generator. A big one.

ch07_annex_gate.g7.t: ...Well. That would do it. I'll lift the gate. Mind the lower wing. Something's been in and out of it.

ch07_annex_gate.tjoin.t: ...I'd like that. I'd like to be relieved. I'll pack the log.

ch07_annex_gate.tstay.t: Yes, sir. Holding the gate. It's what I'm good at.

ch07_annex_holds.h2.t: Holds A1 through A6. My wing. I knew each of them. I named them. Nobody was supposed to name them.

ch07_annex_holds.h5.t: I was level three. I never saw B. Nobody had all the numbers. That was the point of how they built it.

ch07_annex_holds.many.t: I don't know. I honestly don't know. Six from my wing. B wing... I don't know.

ch07_annex_holds.many2.t: There was a page I never had clearance for. 'Integration.' I don't know what they do out there, starving.

ch07_annex_holds.h8.t: [Very quietly] The diesel ran out on day sixteen. The holds warmed. I heard them waking up. I opened the outer door.

ch07_annex_holds.h9.t: I told myself it was to get out. It was. I also didn't close it. I couldn't watch them starve in glass.

ch07_annex_holds.harsh.t: Yes. I did. I'll carry that. I'll help you carry what it costs. That's all I can offer.

ch07_annex_holds.soft.t: ...Thank you. I don't deserve that. I'll take it anyway.

ch07_annex_holds.out.t: There's a hot spring three miles north. If any are still sleeping nearby, they'll be there. In the warm.

ch07_augie_dead_air.a1.t: Denver went quiet an hour ago. Then Omaha. Then the Navy net out of Fallon stopped mid-sentence.

ch07_augie_dead_air.a4.t: [Into a dead handset] Galena. Galena, come in. ...Pete? Anybody?

ch07_augie_dead_air.a5.t: High-altitude burst. Has to be. Fries anything with a chip. Galena's control racks just cooked.

ch07_augie_dead_air.a6.t: The spare transmitter's in the ammo can. Grounded. It might live. What do I tell people, Braith?

ch07_augie_dead_air.truth.t: 'Something terrible happened. We don't know what. Be kind to each other.' ...God. Okay.

ch07_augie_dead_air.foreign.t: Someone to blame. It'll keep them together a while. It'll also get people killed.

ch07_augie_dead_air.fed.t: 'Help is coming.' The oldest lie on the air. Fine. It's yours, not mine.

ch07_dixie_road.t2.t: Lights. Every light you have. Now. They don't like light. They like heat. The engine block is a beacon.

ch07_dixie_road.body.t: [Kneeling by it, very still] A-4. I named her Tamsin. She learned to open her hold latch in March. I'm sorry.

ch07_dixie_road.let.t: It'll remember the flare. They remember. Next time it'll come from the dark side.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.f1.t: Truck stops there. City plates. You with the Army or the Authority?

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.dad_warm.t: He's with me. That's my son. Lift the bar, Javi.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.dad_cold.t: Let him wait a minute. ...Fine. He's my son. Lift it.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.d1.t: Where are you going with a stolen airplane cart and a lady in a space suit?

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.annex.t: That place. Ander's lost two riders out there. Sheep gone in the night. Something big.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.nope.t: Okay. Then you don't know what took forty of Etcheverry's sheep out there either.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.d2.t: Stay. One night. Your brother would like to see you. I'd... it'd be good.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.wes_cage.t: They've got Wes. The Army. In a cage at the Sparks yard. I can't get him. Can you?

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.wes_gone.t: ...He's with you, isn't he. Wes. Of course he is. You always were his hero.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.d3.t: One night. Then go do your crazy thing.

ch07_fallon_checkpoint.nonight.t: Same as always. Go on, then.

ch07_fallon_return.r1.t: You found what you went for. I can see it on you. And something else. You look older.

ch07_fallon_return.r2.t: Ander wants to know what's out there. What's in that fence. Do I tell him you told me?

ch07_fallon_return.tell.t: That'll help us get through the winter. Thank you, son. Ander will owe you. I'll make sure.

ch07_fallon_return.none.t: ...Okay. I believe you. Mostly. I'll keep the riders away.

ch07_fallon_return.bye.t: This might be the last time for a while. Roads'll close when the snow comes.

ch07_fallon_return.honest.t: [Long silence.] ...Your mother'd have liked to hear you say that. So did I. Go on. Go.

ch07_fallon_return.argue.t: Yeah. I suppose we did. Drive safe anyway.

ch07_hotsprings_den.d2.t: Please. They're asleep. They're animals. We made them. Please don't do this.

ch07_hotsprings_den.kill2.t: ...Okay. Okay. That's two fewer. I hope it's enough. I hope you never find out if it was.

ch07_hotsprings_den.walk2.t: Thank you. I know what it might cost. I'm sorry that it might.

ch07_recovery_detail.r1.t: Sergeant First Class Brandt, Task Force Ironwood. We're tasked to secure this facility. Turn around.

ch07_recovery_detail.r2.t: We've been out here three weeks. Nobody's called. We ate the last MRE Sunday. So turn around.

ch07_recovery_detail.ruiz.t: Brandt. It's Nadia. Engineer Two. It's over, Jim. Kessler's holed up in a rail yard. There's no mission.

ch07_recovery_detail.ruiz2.t: ...Ruiz? God. Okay. Okay. Stand down, everybody. It's Ruiz.

ch07_recovery_detail.id.t: Ruiz's ID. She's alive? ...Fine. Fine. We're not shooting anyone with Ruiz's ID.

ch07_recovery_detail.food.t: [He takes it. His hands shake.] ...Okay. We'll talk. Talk while we eat.

ch07_recovery_detail.talked.t: The spares are in cage four. We didn't go in the main building. Nobody goes in there. You'll see why.

ch07_reyne_arrives.r2.t: I saw your light. I've been walking for nine days. I'm Hollis Reyne. I'm a biologist. Was.

ch07_reyne_arrives.r3.t: I heard you on the radio before it died. You need hardened control hardware. I know where there's some.

ch07_reyne_arrives.who.t: Dixie Valley Annex. A contractor site under the Fallon ranges. We studied torpor. Hibernation biology.

ch07_reyne_arrives.where.t: The Annex was built to survive this. EMP-shielded. Hangar full of spares. Generator room. Controls.

ch07_reyne_arrives.r4.t: The diesel ran out in September. The holds warmed. Things... woke up. You've seen them. Your dog has.

ch07_reyne_arrives.r6.t: [Quietly] A hundred miles east. Through Fallon. Through the Compact. Through whatever's out there.

ch07_reyne_arrives.why.t: Because I'm the reason some of them are out here. And because you have lights. I'm afraid of the dark now.

ch07_ruiz.r1.t: Engineer Two to anyone at Peavine. Ironwood's gone dark. Kessler says hold the yard. Half of us are walking.

ch07_ruiz.r3.t: Kessler's holding the Sparks yard with whoever's left. He wants your plant. He'll come for it in winter.

ch07_ruiz.r4.t: Ma'am says you're the mechanic who saved her. We're done with orders. We'll carry stuff. We're good at carrying.

ch07_ruiz.price.t: No price. I owe you. And I'd rather fix something than shoot it. That's all I've got.

ch07_ruiz.join.t: Engineer Two, reporting. ...Unofficially. There's an Ironwood detail out at Dixie Valley. I know their sergeant.

ch07_ruiz.no.t: Okay. Understood. We'll head north. Watch for Kessler. He doesn't forgive.

ch07_where.w1.t: The cards work? Walt says the cards work. So: Galena goes warm. Who goes with it?

ch07_where.w2.t: The plant can heat a few hundred people. Maybe more with a greenhouse. Not the whole city. Never the whole city.

ch07_where.gal.t: Okay. I'll pick the list. No— we'll pick it together. Out loud. With names.

ch07_where.city.t: Then we hold the block. Lolo, Gil, the Pruitts. We hold what we've got until we can do better.

ch07_where.reyne.t: And me? I know how they hunt. I know what light does to them. I'd be useful. I'd also be... a reminder.

ch07_where.rin.t: Thank you. I'll earn it. Every night, I'll earn it.

ch07_where.rout.t: ...Fair. I'll take the cart's old battery. Tolliver will want company. Or he'll shoot me. Either way.

ch08_ames_hand.a1.t: Mechanic. Your hands are your whole life. Let me see.

ch08_ames_hand.saved.t: You gave me power when no one else did. Warm water bath, the good drugs, a heated room. You keep the fingers.

ch08_ames_hand.maybe.t: No heat, no warm bath, no time. I can save the hand. Maybe not both fingers.

ch08_ames_hand.trade.t: ...Fine. Priority. I hate that this works. Lie down.

ch08_ames_hand.end.t: Keep the hand warm. I need that hand. Everyone does.

ch08_annie_greenhouse.a1.t: You came. I've been keeping them alive with candles. Candles are not a long-term agricultural solution.

ch08_annie_greenhouse.a2.t: If Galena runs, a heat line here would make this a greenhouse. Kale, potatoes, beans. Food in the dark.

ch08_annie_greenhouse.yes.t: Thank you. I'll keep the seeds alive until you do. That's a promise between librarians and mechanics.

ch08_annie_greenhouse.trade.t: Iodide. Good trade for a bad sky.

ch08_annie_greenhouse.no.t: No. But it could heat this. Think about it. The seeds will wait. Seeds are patient.

ch08_boone_filters.b1.t: Filters. Twelve. Fresh off the truck. For whiskey, fuel, or that nice rifle.

ch08_boone_filters.check2.t: ...Okay. Okay! Half are good. I'll sort them. Don't tell anybody. Please.

ch08_boone_filters.quiet.t: Thank you. Seriously. You're a good guy. Rarest thing in the yard.

ch08_boone_filters.kess.t: Kessler knows everything. Kessler also needs somebody to trade for his cigarettes.

ch08_deshawn.start.t: Hey. Grandpa says I owe you one. I'm paying it. Come look.

ch08_deshawn.d2.t: Ash can't get in. Grandpa says his dad dug it in the war. We share it. Everyone on the block. You tell people.

ch08_door.d1.t: Please. We walked from Sun Valley. They said there's a house that seals. Please.

ch08_door.d2.t: Address? ...Okay, doesn't matter. Breathing? Okay. Injuries? One arm. Okay. Braith. Your call or mine?

ch08_door.carly.t: Then they're in. Decontaminate in the garage. Strip, wipe, bag the clothes. Then soup.

ch08_door.in2.t: I'm writing their names down. Not on a list. In a book. There's a difference and I'll fight you on it.

ch08_door.no.t: ...Okay. Okay. Come on, babies. We'll find another one.

ch08_door.k1.t: Let me in. I have filters. Let me in, I have filters. ...Braith?

ch08_door.k3.t: [Whispering] That's the Sun Valley mom's voice. She's asleep in the garage. I just checked her.

ch08_henley_house.h3.t: Morning, neighbor. Morning, neighbor. Got any filters? Morning, neighbor.

ch08_henley_house.name.t: Braith? Braith. Let me in. I have filters. Braith?

ch08_henley_house.r1.t: [White-faced] The page I couldn't read. Integration. They don't just take the warmth. They keep what's left.

ch08_henley_house.r2.t: And use it. I didn't know it worked outside a lab. I swear to you I didn't know.

ch08_henley_house.c1.t: That was Dale. That was Dale's voice. Braith. How do we know who's knocking now?

ch08_husk.h1.t: Warm. It's warm in there. I saw the light. My wife's in the car. She's cold. She's so cold.

ch08_husk.talk2.t: ...Pete. I'm Pete. Pete Lund. I left Galena to find my wife. I couldn't find her.

ch08_lolo_list.wes2.t: [Awake. Not pretending otherwise.] You found it. Good. Somebody should know.

ch08_lolo_list.l2.t: [Awake behind you] You found it. Good. Someone should know what this costs.

ch08_lolo_list.l3.t: I help people go, maitia. When it is time and there is nothing else. I write them down so it happened.

ch08_lolo_list.harsh.t: No? Then who? Avila? A soldier? You? At least I hold their hand.

ch08_lolo_list.who.t: Nobody. That's the problem. So somebody who loves them does it. And then carries it.

ch08_lolo_list.who2.t: Your brother is strong. He'll probably never need that page. I write the page anyway.

ch08_lolo_list.burn.t: Burn it, then. I remember every name. The paper was for you, not me.

ch08_mask.m3.t: Then I wear a wet towel and stay inside, and you wear the mask and go out. That's not chivalry, it's logistics.

ch08_mask.find.t: Second thing. First thing is sealing this house. Plastic, tape, everything.

ch08_mask.copy.t: Good. Now seal the house. Plastic, tape, every window. Before the next rain.

ch08_seal.s1.t: Heat stays in, ash stays out. And something else, maitia. Something else stays out.

ch08_seal.s2.t: The things on the ridge. They walk past sealed houses. Salt told me. He's not as crazy as he smells.

ch09_galena_gate.lund.t: WHO GOES— Pearce? PEARCE! Open the gate! It's the mechanic! He brought half of Sparks!

ch09_galena_gate.walt.t: [From the sled, barely a whisper] ...There it is. Hear it? That's... the only good sound...

ch09_galena_gate.end.t: Names. Everybody. Line up by the door. I'm writing everybody down. Everybody.

ch09_kit_sled.k1.t: Wrench! I stole the Army a present. From the Army. It's a cargo sled. Don't ask about the guy who had it.

ch09_kit_sled.k2.t: I owe you like three. This is one. I'm coming too. Somebody has to steal stuff on the way.

ch09_kit_sled.glad.t: Ew. Feelings. Okay. Let's go before I cry from the cold.

ch09_kit_sled.rule.t: I would NEVER. ...From the column. Okay. Rules. Let's go.

ch09_picket.gap.t: East pier. The searchlight's motor hangs every third pass. I installed it. Nine seconds of dark. Go on my mark.

ch09_picket.id.t: Ruiz's ID? ...She's alive? Go. Go before the lieutenant wakes up. I didn't see you.

ch09_salt.alive.t: Airman! Your light's still working. I kept it on all winter. They never came in. Not once.

ch09_salt.alive2.t: There's more of them now. Up the creek. They walk your plant's fence every night. Counting the lights.

ch09_salt.alive3.t: I'm coming with you. Ha. Don't look like that. I can carry. I'm warm-blooded too.

ch09_voices.v1.t: Braith? Over here. Over here. I found the trail. I found the trail, Braith.

ch09_voices.v4.t: [Someone down the line] That's the old man! He's out there! Somebody go get him!

ch09_voices.end.t: New rule, pass it down the line. Nobody answers a voice. Nobody. Not even mine.

ch09_walt.w1.t: Listen. The cards. Rack two, slots four through nine. Sequence matters. Pumps, then fans, then the turbine.

ch09_walt.w2.t: You know it. You knew it in October. I'm just saying it out loud so I can hear it one more time.

ch09_walt.got.t: Good. Good. You're a good crew chief. I'd have hired you.

ch09_walt.you.t: Ha. Sure I will. ...No. I won't. That's okay. I got to hear it run once more. That was the deal.

ch09_walt.w3.t: When you see the steam over the ridge, wake me. I want to see it.

ch09_wraith_hold.w2.t: Flares are almost gone. Braith. They're testing us. They're going to come in.

ch10_epilogue.tc_kit.t: [Radio static] ...Wrench? If you hear this, I'm going over Donner. Owe you three. Bye.

ch10_epilogue.f_both.t: [A letter on a feed receipt] Seed hay on the spring sled. Wes is bossing everybody. Come for lambing. — Dad

ch10_epilogue.f_ross.t: [A letter on a feed receipt] Hay on the spring sled. I'm proud of you. Should've said it first. — Dad

ch10_epilogue.c_here.t: Address? Here. Breathing? Yes. Injuries? ...A few. Okay. Writing it down. So it happened.

ch10_final.f1.t: The Floor fed this city for a year. We run it as a kitchen. Everybody eats. Everybody works.

ch10_final.f2.t: Without a count, you feed everyone for a month and then no one. Give me the plant. I'll keep a list. An honest one.

ch10_final.f3.t: Galena heats three hundred. Fallon's geothermal field could heat a thousand of ours. The turbines come east.

ch10_final.f4.t: Or we don't hand it to anyone. We sit at one table and fight about it every night. Names on the wall. All of them.

ch10_final.authority.t: Thank you. I'll read the list aloud every Sunday. Including the names I cross off.

ch10_final.compact.t: Your father will be proud. The city will curse you. Both will be right.

ch10_gate.k1.t: Pearce. Dale Kessler. I've got forty-one soldiers, no fuel, and orders from nobody. I need your heat.

ch10_gate.stand.t: Sergeant Ruiz tells me you're the kind who opens doors. So. I'm asking. Not ordering. I'm tired of ordering.

ch10_gate.in.t: ...Done. God. Done. You'll want my generator mechanics. And my floodlights. I have floodlights.

ch10_gate.half.t: Fair. Fair. I'd have done the same. Take care of them.

ch10_gate.fight.t: Then I'm sorry. Nobody wins this one.

ch10_siege_night1.n2r.t: They're testing. One light. To see what we do. Whatever we do, they'll remember it.

ch10_siege_night2.v1.t: [From the dark past the north fence] Halvorsen's here. He's fine. Open the gate. Open the gate, Pearce.

ch10_siege_night2.n2.t: They got Halvorsen! Off the north pole! And the water line's split, Pearce! The pressure's dropping!

ch10_siege_night3.n2.t: [On the radio] North pole four's dark! East three flickering! Braith, which one?

spot.t: Hey! The bag. Drop the bag.

idle.t: Hot as hell under here.
Who's got the lighter?
Viaduct's ours. Viaduct's always ours.

spot.t: Back off! I saw it first!

idle.t: Batteries, batteries... come on.
Just one more house. Just one.

spot.t: Stay back! I've got kids in here!

idle.t: Shh. Shh. It's okay. I'm here.
Two cans left. Make it three days.

greet.t: We don't have anything. I swear.

spot.t: Hold it. This block's under watch.

death.t: This was supposed to be... a block party.

idle.t: Curfew's at dark. Everybody knows that.
I'm writing down plates. Somebody has to.

greet.t: You live here? Name and house number.

idle.t: Fourteen-hour shift. Fourteen.
Anybody got water? Real water?
Checkpoint four, all quiet. Out.

greet.t: Ration line's that way. Keep moving.

spot.t: Hold up, neighbor. Who you with?

attack.t: That dog won't hunt! Light 'em up!

idle.t: Sleet's gonna come sideways tonight.
Hay grew here. Hay stays here.
Thermos is empty. Again.

greet.t: You eat today? Here. Don't make it weird.

spot.t: Hey! Who's that by the loading dock?

death.t: Make sure... the soup goes out...

idle.t: Three thousand plates. Same as yesterday.
Who's on soup tonight? Show of hands.
Kitchen's warm. Ish.

greet.t: Here's the deal. You work, you eat.
You with us? Grab a sack.

trade.t: Grain for tools. Fair weight. We use a scale.
Spur chips or tools. Fair's fair.

spot.t: Federal Directive. Stop where you are.

hurt.t: Three-One is hit, say again, hit!

idle.t: Command, Ironwood Two-Two. All quiet. Over.
Barstow's eating rats, man. Rats.
Nine days of grain. Nine days.

spot.t: Fuel. Drop the fuel and walk.
Movement, Sparks block. One. Coat and pack.

idle.t: Nobody's answered since December, Sarge.
Can't feel my hands.
Change the filter. Change it.

spot.t: Is that... you? Is it you?

attack.t: I need it! I need it!

idle.t: So hot. Why's it so hot.
Where did they go...
Mm. Mm. Home. Home's this way.

spot.t: Unregistered individual detected. Remain where you are.
You are inside a federal enforcement zone.

idle.t: Curfew is in effect. Return to your residence.
Unreported fuel or food is subject to confiscation.

greet.t: What're you buying, what're you selling?
Cash is no good. Show me steel.

trade.t: That's a jug. Not a drop more.

idle.t: Prices went up. Weather went down.
Filters, batteries, salt. Ask.

spot.t: Hands where I can see 'em. Then we talk.
Easy! We're not with them anymore.

attack.t: Back off! We got nothing left!

idle.t: Irwin's four hundred miles. We walk.
Sarge says east. We go east.
Left boot. Right boot. Don't look at his face.
Sorry, buddy. Sorry.

mimic.t: Let me in. I have filters.
Let me in, I have filters. ...Braith?
Over here. I found the trail.
Open the gate. Open the gate, Pearce.

ch01_carly_home.c0.t: [Ears up. One sharp bark. Tail going like a prop.]

ch01_kit_pharmacy.k0.t: [Freezes. Low growl. Points at the back room.]

ch02_crush.c1.t: [Bracing against your leg. Barking at the crowd, high and frantic.]

ch02_ridge_glimpse.g1.t: [Stops dead. Stares east. A thin, rising whine you've never heard from her.]

ch02_ridge_glimpse.what.t: [She won't look away. Her hackles stay up all the way to the bridge.]

ch03_gil_fire.start.t: [Out of a dead sleep. Barking at the window. Orange light on the ceiling.]

ch03_wes_arrives.w1.t: [Not a warning bark. A happy one. She knows that engine.]

ch04_dutch_ambush.start.t: [Freezes in the road. Growls at the culvert ahead.]

ch04_salt_culvert.s4.t: [Pressed against your leg. Shaking. She hasn't stopped looking up the draw.]

ch06_alley_glimpse.g3.t: [She doesn't growl. She presses against your legs and shakes.]

ch07_annex_holds.h6.t: [Won't go down the stairs. Sits at the top. Whines once. Then silence.]

ch07_annex_holds.tall.t: [Suddenly on her feet. Barking. Backing away from the dark end of the A-wing corridor.]

ch07_dixie_road.t1.t: [On her feet in the truck bed. Not growling. Shaking. Staring into the dark.]

ch07_reyne_arrives.start.t: [Growling at the door. Not her Tallman shaking. A human growl. Suspicious.]

ch08_door.d0.t: [Nose to the door crack. Tail low. A soft whine. Their breath fogs the glass. Sick, scared, real.]

ch08_door.k2w.t: [Backing away from the door. Hackles up. Not barking. A growl so low it's almost silence.]

ch08_henley_house.h1.t: [Stops on the porch. Hackles up from neck to tail. A growl so low you feel it in your boots.]

ch08_husk.h1w.t: [Ears back. A soft, worried whine. She noses his hand. His breath smokes. Sick, not wrong.]

ch08_husk.fight2.t: [Wraith growls at the dark beyond him. Not at him. Something's been following him.]

ch09_voices.v3w.t: [Planted. Hackles up. Growling at the voice. Then she looks at you: don't.]

ch10_siege_night1.n2.t: [On her feet. Facing the dark lamp. Low, steady growl.]

ch10_siege_night2.v2w.t: [Hackles up. Growling at the voice, not the fence. She won't go near the north gate.]

ch10_siege_night3.n1.t: [Barking at the east fence. Then the north. Showing you where. Over and over.]
